note: Categorisation of all 33 StatsBomb event types in the 417 eligible matches (2026-10-27). Categories follow the StatsBomb Open Data event specification (data/raw/statsbomb/doc) and are this research's own classification; the measured properties used to justify scenario D are in type_stats.csv / companions.csv.

categories.on_ball_action: a player acts on the ball in live play (decision of the ball carrier or a contest for the ball)
categories.defensive_action: a defending player's action in live play (with or without touching the ball)
categories.goalkeeper_action: an action of the goalkeeper (save, claim, punch, collection, ...)
categories.derived_companion: recorded as the counterpart of another event at the same moment (StatsBomb pairs it with its partner)
categories.retrospective_annotation: an annotation that depends on what happened next (not observable at the moment)
categories.restart_or_stoppage: the ball is out of play / play restarted by the referee / stoppage marker

scenario_rules.A: current production: the 8 MEANINGFUL_EVENT_TYPES as inputs and targets
scenario_rules.B: every raw event type is a target; every event with a 360 record is an input
scenario_rules.C: all football actions: categories on_ball_action, defensive_action, goalkeeper_action, foul_or_discipline except Bad Behaviour/Offside, and derived_companion except Own Goal For; excludes administrative, restart_or_stoppage, retrospective_annotation and referee sanctions
scenario_rules.D: C minus derived companions (a deterministic counterpart of another event at the same moment adds no new decision), minus types with fewer than 1,000 eligible occurrences; finalised from measured companion rates (see README)
